Response re-weighting (rate x F2_alt/F2_shell) shows a numerical spike at the 129Xe Sigma' node (375 keV) for the thin-shell proxy; outside the ROI, so Fig. 3 was restricted to 350 keV; window results unaffected.

First interpretation of the Fig. 6 bottom axis as (d10 m_v^2)^2 rejected: label tokens read 'd^s_10 (dimensionless)' and the squared reading would imply 2.0-7.1 events at the interval edges versus 0.31-3.9 for the linear reading (one-event PLR interval ~0.1-3.7).
